Sample Triplets for Class Angular Distortion

Source: R/class-angular-distortion.R
sample_class_triplets.Rd

The anchor comes from one class and two distinct endpoints come from another. Draws are independent and may repeat. Each eligible triplet has equal probability, so a directed class pair with a anchor members and b endpoint members has weight proportional to a * choose(b, 2).

Usage

sample_class_triplets(labels, n_triplets = NULL)

Arguments

labels

A vector without missing values, with one label per observation and at least two distinct labels. At least one class must have two members to supply endpoints.

n_triplets

Total number of triplets to sample. The default is ten times the number of observations.

Value

An integer matrix with one-based columns anchor, endpoint1, and endpoint2.

References

Gunaratne, Kobourov and Miller (2026) define the class triplets used by CADI. https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.00637 Their implementation samples classes first. Quadra gives each eligible triplet equal probability.

See also

class_angular_distortion_index()

Examples

set.seed(42)
sample_class_triplets(c("A", "A", "A", "B", "B", "C"), 5)
#>      anchor endpoint1 endpoint2
#> [1,]      6         5         4
#> [2,]      1         5         4
#> [3,]      5         1         3
#> [4,]      1         5         4
#> [5,]      5         3         1
